newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal sets 20 bln esc variable rate repo.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal sets 20 bln esc variable rate repo.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal offered to inject 20 billion escudos of three-day funds into the money market in a variable rate securities repurchase tender.

The central bank also offered to drain liquidity today with three-day certificates at a fixed rate of 5.80 percent. Its emergency lending rate for up to 100 billion escudos of one-day funds to resident banks stands at 7.80 percent.
Bids for the repo funds must be submitted by 0900 GMT and bids for the certificates by 1400 GMT.

--Lisbon bureau 3511-3150035 LISBOA, 2 Mai (Reuter) - O Banco de Portugal (BP) propos ceder ate 20 milhoes de contos (MC) contra Bilhetes do Tesouro, Obrigacoes do Tesouro e Titulos de Deposito (BT/OT/TD), a tres dias, em leilao, anunciou a instituicao.
A anterior taxa media ponderada (TMP) da cedencia saiu a 6,3 pct.
A entrega de propostas para esta cedencia decorre ate as 1000 horas locais. O resultado sera anunciado na pagina BPDF.
A entrega de propostas para a facilidade permanente de absorcao de fundos, ate ao final do periodo de reservas, a taxa fixa de 5,8 pct, decorre ate as 1500 horas locais.
As propostas para a facilidade permanente de cedencia diaria de emergencia, a taxa fixa de 7,8 pct, decorre igualmente ate as 1500 horas locais.
Ambas as facilidade permanentes nao tem limite de montante.
